changes: Killing enemies now grants Gold and EXP, shown in a new Progression panel
Added character leveling — gain levels as you earn EXP, with a level-up notification
Ranged classes (Hunter, Wuxia) can now attack from much farther away than melee classes
Click an enemy to auto-engage it — your hero walks over and keeps attacking until it dies
Initial project setup with sign-in and an isometric world to walk around in
Added the four classes (Hunter, Twin-soul, Wuxia, Juggernaut) with attribute-based stats
Added a first pass at combat: attack a nearby enemy and watch it take damage and fall
Added version tracking, a changelog, and What's New notifications
